formal-identities.text: The frozen Lean model is the authority. Addresses are illustrative natural numbers, application evidence is supplied, and refunds are commitments rather than payment flows. Finite corpus agreement does not prove universal parity. The clarity record lists theorem gaps, missing refusal exhibits, and template adaptations. This is a simulator candidate, not an accepted or proved system.

The executable model, theorem statements, trace driver, and corrected corpus are each bound by SHA two hundred and fifty six. Changing a bound input invalidates the current evidence. Final checks use the corrected fifty eight row corpus, not the initial snapshot.

decisions-and-model-limits.text: The clarity table ties every interpretation to a formal definition. Numeric names and addresses are illustrative. Competing Inserts can queue, but a batch fails atomically if an item fails. Cancellation binds the exact refund without modeling its payment. Application evidence is supplied, terminal custody makes resolution pending, and safe integer limits belong to the simulator.

naming-profile-identities-and-limits.text: The naming profile binds its model, helper proofs, seventeen theorem statements, executable corpus, and theorem inventory by SHA two hundred and fifty six. Fifteen theorem rows have controlled finite checks and two transition equations are exhibits only. The page derives seventeen exact-name lamps from the inventory. Public JavaScript entry points enforce exact naming shapes, nested numeric domains, complete validation of supported actions, exported spelling resolution, replay validation, and a queue-time fixture snapshot. Unsupported action constructors are refused before their payloads are interpreted. These are simulator-boundary and finite-corpus results, not ledger or signature evidence.

theorem-coverage-gaps.text: All forty one declarations were stated with admitted proof debt when this record was written, and have since been proved without changing any statement. Twelve have controlled finite checks, seventeen have action exhibits, and twelve lack a nonvacuous executable exhibit. The named gaps include commitment properties, element and sequential fold equivalences, supply and retirement properties, request spending, approval scope, and address and pending resolution equivalences. Action exhibits do not check full quantified statements.

refusal-coverage-and-reconciliation-limi.text: The model source names twenty eight distinct refusal reasons. Seventeen have corpus or story exhibits; the other eleven are listed explicitly. Source hashes and finite replay do not establish complete guard-conjunct coverage. Full bidirectional reconciliation of prose claims and guard conjuncts remains an instrumentation limitation.

template-adaptation.text: The page starts from the shared template and retains its first stylesheet and shared DOM and immutable-tree helpers. Singular-specific panels, rendering, wiring, and a second stylesheet adapt the page to this model. Full generic-renderer identity is not claimed. The shared template is provenance rather than formal authority.

verification-boundary.text: Focused checks cover fifty eight generic corpus rows, thirty four naming corpus rows, thirty two story actions, forty one generic theorem identities, seventeen naming identities and lamps, one thousand seven hundred and seventy two public-boundary probes, and forty three negative controls. Two naming equations remain exhibits only. The incorrect-acceptance fault changes only refused transitions and must fail on the terminal-withdrawal refusal case. Local browser evidence is separate from publication and independent audit.
